decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed shop front would provide inadequate access for persons with disabilities and its design not be in keeping with the character and style of the building and adjoining premises within this shopping parade, which would harm the apperance of the street scene.  This would be contrary to adopted policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities, S.4.2 (Shop Front Design), S.4.4 (Access to Shopping Facilities), and supplementary guidance Think Access of the Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - In the absence of adequate details of what is proposed, the Local Planning Authority has no option but to refuse planning permission as it cannot satisfy itself that the appearance of the proposed development would not harm the character and appearance of the local area.
description: Erection of an external staircase to rear of premises and installation of new shop front.
